raidSayLines.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Larry Giordano. Truck driver. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Field suture kit, Hard Candy, Trail compass, Mixtape, Search locket. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night, somethi
A woman, maybe 50s: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
🦎 "Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES! So we made BETTER ones!" (Something new is crying in the treeline.)
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.

Three shapes at the treeline — dog-shaped silences, circling. (A real pack is out there now: 3 of them. No names yet — nobody's lived to argue about one.)
The Hushpuppy stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.

Nobody met Cliffhanger — it's still out there at the treeline. It'll gorge every night until it's driven off.

🌙 Night. The lingering Cliffhanger gorges at the treeline — 1,298 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 2 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Lucia Kim. From Emberhold." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
More travelers at the treeline — 2 of them — but there's already a petition at your fire. One thing at a time. They make camp outside to wait.

💬 Aria pulls you aside. "I need to tell you something. Last night I... dreamed? No. I was AWAKE. And something spoke to me. Not the System — something else. It said: 'Tell the human to watch the northern treeline.' Then it was gone."
🌙 Night. Shouts from the treeline — Sanne of Ashford with 3 others, and they're not here to talk. "Your pantry or your blood. Choose." (They want ~2,000 kcal.)
